note: Common Control Framework. A safeguard is the operated object: it carries one evidence requirement and one evaluation rule, and satisfies many framework requirements. Framework readiness is derived from safeguard posture, not the other way round. Every control_id under `satisfies` must exist in controls/catalog.json. A mapping is `reviewed` once a human has confirmed the requirements are genuinely the same obligation; `proposed` mappings were matched by title theme and are reported separately so unconfirmed work is never counted as attested coverage.

safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current identity, access review, privileged access, or authorization policy evidence exists and has no open high-risk failure.

safeguards.objective: Document intended and beneficial uses, deployment settings, users, applicable expectations, impacts, assumptions, limitations and relevant evaluation metrics.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: A reviewed context record links each AI system to intended uses, deployment environments, affected users and communities, applicable laws and norms, beneficial and adverse impacts, assumptions, limitations and TEVV metrics. Missing business or deployment context is recorded as unknown.

safeguards.objective: Define the AI tasks and methods that support each intended use.

safeguards.title: Threat likelihood and impact prioritization
safeguards.objective: Identify potential threat impacts and likelihoods, then use threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood and impact to prioritize inherent risk.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: A current risk assessment links threats and vulnerabilities to affected assets, likelihood, business impact and the rationale for response priority. Production, customer exposure and internal use are explicit context where known; unknown values remain unknown.

safeguards.objective: Choose, prioritize, plan, track and communicate risk responses.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Risk response records connect each prioritized risk to a treatment decision, accountable owner, planned actions, tracking status and communication evidence. A suggestion without a selected and tracked response is insufficient.

safeguards.evidence_requirement: A monitoring plan defines scope, accountable roles, review frequency, last review and next review, and links to current monitoring results. A live connection indicator alone does not demonstrate risk monitoring.

safeguards.objective: Implement post-deployment monitoring covering feedback, appeals, overrides, decommissioning, incident response, recovery and change management.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current monitoring and response records demonstrate implemented feedback evaluation, user appeals and overrides, decommissioning, incident handling, recovery and change management for deployed AI systems. Plans without implementation evidence are incomplete.
